general.label: All-stack
general.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt.js
general.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 6+ years delivering production products across React/Next.js and Vue/Nuxt. At Sazito, I moved from part-time to full-time in July 2026 after four years alongside my Jack Westin role; I own frontend initiatives across commerce workflows and cut theme-builder build time from 15 minutes to 2. At Jack Westin, I owned a backward-compatible Nuxt 2 to Nuxt Bridge migration, a Vue 3 UI kit reused across products, Nuxt 4 SSR marketing pages, and frontend delivery for a Chrome extension listed with 40,000+ users. Earlier, as Chamedoon's sole frontend developer, I raised historical Lighthouse scores to 98 Performance, 100 Accessibility, 100 Best Practices, and 96 SEO.

experience.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
experience.type: Part-time through Jun 2026; Full-time from Jul 2026
experience.context: E-commerce platform serving 6,000+ stores, 5M+ users, and 10 trillion Iranian rials (IRR) in monthly transaction volume.
highlights: Moved Sazito's marketing and landing pages from React to Next.js as the sole frontend owner, strengthening SSR, SEO, and Core Web Vitals.
Cut theme-builder build time from 15 minutes to 2 by restructuring theme-generation and build workflows.
Delivered merchant-controlled font and primary/accent color settings, plus customer reviews with photo/video attachments and admin moderation.
Migrated the legacy React application's Sass/node-sass styling to Tailwind CSS while preserving active storefront and admin behavior.
Partnered with a teammate on a Node.js SDK/API for standalone merchant themes, optimizing request and payload data; independently built a sample Next.js theme using the SDK.
Review teammate changes and deliver storefront/admin workflows for product imports, payments, shipping, search, and cart, aligning implementation across the platform.

experience.title: Frontend Engineer
highlights: Owned frontend delivery for a Chrome extension listed with 40,000+ users, implementing Vue 3 study UI with Shadow DOM isolation and cross-context messaging.
Led the Nuxt 2 to Nuxt Bridge migration for the main site, upgrading dependencies incrementally while preserving backward compatibility.
Built Vue 3 components for a shared UI kit adopted across multiple products, centralizing maintenance and aligning interface patterns.
Delivered SEO-focused landing and marketing pages in Nuxt 4 using server-rendering and generation workflows.
Added comprehensive tests for extension and shared UI flows, reviewed teammate code, and collaborated remotely across product, design, backend, and QA.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
experience.context: Travel product for flight booking and hotel reservations; the service was later discontinued during the COVID-era travel downturn.
highlights: Served as the sole frontend developer, owning responsive Vue/Nuxt delivery for flight booking and hotel reservation workflows.
Raised historical Lighthouse scores from 65 to 98 in Performance, 75 to 100 in Accessibility, 90 to 100 in Best Practices, and 78 to 96 in SEO.
Improved FCP, LCP, CLS, and TBT alongside accessibility, responsive Sass interfaces, Vuex/TypeScript state, and REST API flows.
Partnered directly with product and backend teams to shape requirements, debug production issues, and maintain the frontend.
